svg.title: Hi, I'm Qarina
svg.desc: An Informatics graduate from Universitas Diponegoro who enjoys the whole journey of building software, from understanding the problem to shipping something people actually use. Interested in Business analysis, System design, Development, Testing, AI integration. On rotation: PHP, JavaScript, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, Laravel, React.js, Next.js, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Alibaba Cloud, Google Cloud, Docker, Git, GitHub.
